<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/becoming-a-parent">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SocialSecurityNotification" name="Social Security notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyNotification" name="Company notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyInformation" name="Company information"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_BecomingAParent" name="Becoming A Parent" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Planning" name="Maternity leave planning begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Fetch</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchModels" name="Fetch information about potential leave models">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Fetch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Fetch_Select</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectModel" name="Let parent select a leave model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Fetch_Select</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_Collect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_Collect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_NotifySplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NotifySplit" name="Notify both parties">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Collect_NotifySplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifySocialSecurity</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifyCompanies</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Notify Social Security in time" messageRef="Message_SocialSecurityNotification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifySocialSecurity</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SocialSecurity_NotifyJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCompanies" name="Notify companies in time" messageRef="Message_CompanyNotification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifyCompanies</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Companies_NotifyJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NotifyJoin" name="Notifications complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SocialSecurity_NotifyJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Companies_NotifyJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifyJoin_Gather</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" name="Gather information from companies" messageRef="Message_CompanyInformation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifyJoin_Gather</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Gather_Decide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideExtension" name="Let parent decide about extension at the end of the period">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Gather_Decide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decide_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" name="Extension decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decide_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExtensionChosen</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoExtensionChosen</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ExtensionChosen" name="Extension chosen">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExtensionChosen</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoExtensionChosen" name="No extension chosen">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoExtensionChosen</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Fetch" sourceRef="StartEvent_Planning" targetRef="Task_FetchModels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fetch_Select" sourceRef="Task_FetchModels" targetRef="Task_SelectModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Collect" sourceRef="Task_SelectModel" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_NotifySplit" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Gateway_NotifySplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifySocialSecurity" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyCompanies" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="Task_NotifyCompanies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SocialSecurity_NotifyJoin" sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Companies_NotifyJoin" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompanies" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyJoin_Gather" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gather_Decide" sourceRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" targetRef="Task_DecideExtension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decide_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_DecideExtension" targetRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExtensionChosen" name="Extension chosen" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_ExtensionChosen">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" language="http://www.w3.org/1999/XPath">$extensionChosen = true()</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoExtensionChosen" name="No extension chosen" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_NoExtensionChosen">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" language="http://www.w3.org/1999/XPath">$extensionChosen = false()</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BecomingAParent">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ParentProcess" name="Maternity leave planning" processRef="Process_BecomingAParent"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SocialSecurity" name="Social Security"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Companies" name="Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Social Security notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Participant_SocialSecurity" messageRef="Message_SocialSecurityNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifyCompanies" name="Company notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompanies" targetRef="Participant_Companies" messageRef="Message_CompanyNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyInformation" name="Company information" sourceRef="Participant_Companies" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" messageRef="Message_CompanyInformation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that one activity must happen before another: Model the activities with sequence flows in the stated order, not as concurrent branches.
rules.situation: the description states that one activity must happen before another

rules.instruction: When the description states a decision or activity but does not specify an alternative outcome: Label the corresponding BPMN activity without adding an alternative outcome that the description does not state.
rules.situation: the description states a decision or activity but does not specify an alternative outcome

rules.instruction: When the description presents activities in an order, states a decision outcome that leads to an activity, or identifies an event that determines what happens next.: Connect each stated transition with a sequence flow, including from the start event to the first activity, from each decision branch to its specified next step, and from an event-based gateway to its catching-event target.
rules.situation: the description presents activities or decisions in a stated order, or states what follows from a decision

rules.instruction: Use bpmn:userTask for human work assisted by software and bpmn:manualTask for human work performed without an execution application.
rules.situation: the description assigns a person a selection or decision and gives no indication that the work is assisted by an execution application
